marc:datafield.marc:subfield: With stunning clarity, veterans of the most memorable conflicts tell never-before-heard stories of rescues, sniper attacks, ambushes and hand-to-hand combat. Legendary battles are re-created shot in vivid, crisp detail through state-of-the-art 3-D animation sequences. Coupled with eyewitness reports from military experts and soldiers, these blow-by-blow re-creations of some of history's bloodiest confrontations take viewers to the front lines of military operations from the perspectives of the soldiers, making shootout the most accurate gun battle series ever created.
